  - No exclusion terms (e.g., "Mahnung", "Zahlungserinnerung") prominent.
  - Conclusion: treat as invoice.

- Locate invoice date:
  - Found "Datum: 07.11.2022" near header. Use Invoice.Date = "07.11.2022".

- Locate totals:
  - Multiple total lines show "€   250,00" (Summe, Zwischensumme, Auftragssumme, Rechnungssumme, Gesamt netto).
  - Grand total payable appears as "Rechnungssumme: €   250,00" and "Gesamt netto: €   250,00".
  - Set GrandTotal.Amount = 250.00 (preserve two decimals).

- VAT information:
  - Text includes "Steuerfreie innergemeinschaftliche Lieferung" indicating VAT-exempt transaction.
  - No explicit VAT percentage rate present.
  - Per No Inference, leave Vat.Rate = "" and Vat.Amount = "".

- Net amount:
  - Since totals show "Gesamt netto: €   250,00", set Net.Amount = 250.00.

- Sender VAT ID:
  - Found "Unsere UID-Nr.: SK4120251047" (explicitly labeled as "our UID").
  - Also another UID appears on page 2 ("UID ATU77326234"), but the header explicitly labels "Unsere UID-Nr.: SK4120251047".
  - Choose Sender.VatId = "SK4120251047" (explicit "Unsere UID-Nr.").

- Decimal formatting:
  - Maintain two decimal places as in source (250,00 -> 250.00).

- Apply No Inference rule for any missing/ambiguous fields.

These findings will be used to populate the required JSON fields.
